Staff.List.Title: Staff
Staff.List.Subtitle: Your team and their weekly working hours.
Staff.List.Empty: No staff members yet. Add the first one to start building the rota.
Staff.Create.Title: Add a staff member
Staff.Create.DisplayNameHint: Shown to clients when they choose who to book with.
Staff.Create.ColourHint: Appointments of this person show in this colour.
Staff.Create.Created: “{0}” has been added. Set their working hours next.
Staff.Create.Validation.NameTooLong: The name can have at most {0} characters.
Staff.Create.Validation.EmailTooLong: The email can have at most {0} characters.
Staff.Create.Validation.PhoneTooLong: The phone number can have at most {0} characters.
Staff.Hours.Title: Working hours
Staff.Hours.Hint: Times are in the salon's local time, in 5-minute steps. Leave a day blank or tick “Day off” when this person does not work.
Staff.Hours.Validation.DaysInvalid: The form must list each day of the week once.
Staff.Hours.Validation.EndAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
Staff.Hours.Validation.Overlap: The two shifts on this day overlap.
Staff.Edit.Title: Edit staff member
Staff.Edit.IsActive: Still works here (untick to hide this person and stop new bookings)
Staff.TimeOff.Title: Time off
Staff.TimeOff.Hint: Days or hours when this person is away. Clients cannot book these times; existing appointments stay as they are.
Staff.TimeOff.TimesHint: Leave both blank for whole days, or set the hours blocked on each day.
Staff.TimeOff.Deleted: The time off has been removed.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.ToBeforeFrom: The last day cannot be before the first day.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.SpanTooLong: Time off can cover at most {0} days; split a longer absence into two entries.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.TimesIncomplete: Enter both a start and an end time, or leave both blank for whole days.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.EndAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.ReasonTooLong: The reason can have at most {0} characters.
Staff.TimeOff.Validation.Overlap: This person already has time off in that period.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Title: Calendar on a phone
Staff.CalendarFeed.Lead: This person's visits can show in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook, next to their own plans. The calendar reads them from a private address.
Staff.CalendarFeed.OffState.Title: The address is switched off
Staff.CalendarFeed.Shows: Each visit shows as the service with the client's first name and the initial of the last name, at the salon's address. No phone numbers and no notes leave the salon.
Staff.CalendarFeed.On.Title: The address is on
Staff.CalendarFeed.AddressHint: Press and hold to copy it, then send it to this person only.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Step.Google: Google Calendar on a computer: “Other calendars”, “From URL”, paste the address.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Step.Apple: iPhone: Settings, Calendar, Accounts, “Add Subscribed Calendar”, paste the address.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Step.Wait: The calendar reads the address a few times a day, so a new visit can take some hours to show there. The salon's own calendar is always up to date.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Secret.Title: Keep the address private
Staff.CalendarFeed.Secret.Text: Anyone who has the address can see these visits. If it went to the wrong person, or this person leaves, make a new address or switch it off. The old address stops working at once.
Staff.CalendarFeed.SwitchedOn: The address is on. Paste it into the calendar.
Staff.CalendarFeed.Replaced: There is a new address. The old one no longer works.
Staff.CalendarFeed.SwitchedOff: The address is switched off. It no longer works.
Staff.Commission.Title: Commission
Staff.Commission.Lead: What you pay each person as a share of their work and of the products sold on their visits. Leave a box empty for someone who is not paid that way.
Staff.Commission.Hint: A visit keeps the rates of the day it is completed, so changing a rate here changes the visits done from now on. Only the owner can change them.
Staff.Commission.Validation.Rate: Enter a percent from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals, or leave it empty.
Staff.Photo.Title: Photo
Staff.Photo.Lead: Clients see this face when they choose who to book with.
Staff.Photo.None: No photo yet. Clients see the first letter of the name until you add one.
Staff.Photo.FileHint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP picture of at most {0} KB. It is shown in a circle, so a square picture of the face works best.
Staff.Photo.Problem.TooLarge: That picture is larger than {0} KB. Choose a smaller one: a cropped copy or a screenshot of it is usually small enough.
Staff.Photo.Problem.NotAPicture: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
